Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00
; ______________________________________________________________________________
; Cybera - Cyber Cafe Administration
; This file contains all the registry keys that are liable to be modified on 
; the Workstations if User Account Lockdown is enabled. 
; This file, if run, will unlock all the locked features of the workstation as 
; long as the user has admin rights on the local computer.
; $Id: cybera_unlock_reg.txt 4 2005-12-18 17:47:52Z sam $

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System]
"DisableChangePassword"=dword:00000000
"DisableLockWorkstation"=dword:00000000
"NoDispCPL"=dword:00000000
"DisableRegistryTools"=dword:00000000
"DisableTaskMgr"=dword:00000000

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer]
"NoClose"=dword:00000000
"NoLogoff"=dword:00000000
"NoSimpleStartMenu"=dword:00000000
"NoRun"=dword:00000000
"NoActiveDesktop"=dword:00000000
"NoSetTaskbar"=dword:00000000
"NoSetFolders"=dword:00000000
"NoFolderOptions"=dword:00000000
"NoTrayContextMenu"=dword:00000000
"NoViewContextMenu"=dword:00000000
"NoNetConnectDisconnect"=dword:00000000
"NoFind"=dword:00000000
"NoSaveSettings"=dword:00000000
"NoGoTo"=dword:00000000
"NoDisconnect"=dword:00000000
"NoFileAssociate"=dword:00000000
"NoRecentDocsMenu"=dword:00000000
"NoFavoritesMenu"=dword:00000000
"NoOptions"=dword:00000000
"NoNTSecurity"=dword:00000000
"NoCommonGroups"=dword:00000000
"NoNetHood"=dword:00000000
"NoDrives"=hex:00,00,00,00

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\Restrictions]
"NoBrowserOptions"=dword:00000000
"NoFileNew"=dword:00000000
"NoFindFiles"=dword:00000000
"NoSelectDownloadDir"=dword:00000000
"NoTheaterMode"=dword:00000000

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\Infodelivery\Restrictions]
"NoAddingChannels"=dword:00000000
"NoAddingSubscriptions"=dword:00000000
"NoSearchCustomization"=dword:00000000
"NoRemovingChannels"=dword:00000000
"NoRemovingSubscriptions"=dword:00000000

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\Control Panel]
"Connwiz Admin Lock"=dword:00000000

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\Main]
"Disable Script Debugger"="no"
"Use FormSuggest"="yes"
"FormSuggest Passwords"="yes"
"Err Dlg Displayed On Every Error"="yes"
"Use Custom Search URL"=dword:00000001

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsMediaPlayer]
"NoFindNewStations"=dword:00000000
"NoMediaFavorites"=dword:00000000
"NoRadioBar"=dword:00000000

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Internet Connection Wizard]
"CanInstallISPKit5"="yes"
